name: OrendaBox Hotspot
description: Start a WiFi hotspot on your OrendaBox so nearby phones, tablets and laptops can open Box-hosted web apps. Choose the WiFi name and password, and optionally share the Box internet connection. If the Box uses WiFi as its uplink, you can release it from the app once Ethernet or mobile data keeps the Box online. The Box owns the access point and keeps management behind Edge Console sign-in.
